name: Duval County, FL
findings: Duval County has 3,544 nonprofit organizations. 1,300 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,012 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Duval County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few political organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 6 political organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 19 would.

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through political groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Duval County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 78 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 394 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
